steps.title: Configure TessBaseAPI and Asset File Initialization
steps.description: Configured OcrScannerHelper to copy eng.traineddata from assets into the local tesseract/tessdata directory and initialize TessBaseAPI with clear status logging.

steps.title: Implement Native TessBaseAPI OCR Extraction Methods
steps.description: Updated extractTextFromTesseract to invoke setImage(Bitmap), getUTF8Text(), and clear() on TessBaseAPI instances.

steps.title: Integrate Multi-Angle Rotation with ZXing and Tesseract
steps.description: Combined multi-directional barcode decoding with native Tesseract text extraction for live camera frames and gallery images.

steps.title: Refine IMEI 1 and IMEI 2 Luhn Extraction Rules
steps.description: Enforced strict 15-digit Luhn checksum verification and digit correction for IMEI slot recognition.

steps.title: Enhance Hardware Attributes and Label Parsers
steps.description: Expanded pattern matchers for Brand, Model, Color, RAM, Storage, and Serial Number identifiers.

steps.title: Optimize Non-Blocking Frame Processing Pipeline
steps.description: Ensured camera frame preview handling remains smooth while performing asynchronous OCR processing.

steps.title: Maintain Safe Product Field Prefill and Non-Overwriting Logic
steps.description: Updated product form dialog in MainActivity to preserve existing user input when scanning.

steps.title: Verify SQLite Inventory and Stock History Operations
steps.description: Verified seamless SQLite database interaction for inventory records, stock IN, stock OUT, and transaction recalculations.

steps.title: Verify Java 8 Compatibility Standards
steps.description: Validated code against Java 8 language restrictions using anonymous inner classes and Temurin 17 build constraints.

steps.title: Validate Debug Build Environment
steps.description: Tested Gradle 8.5 build scripts and Manifest configurations.

steps.title: Building Box Stock Manager
steps.description: Compile final APK with offline TessBaseAPI OCR support, multi-format barcode scanning, and stock management.
